about: Hand labels for the planner eval (lane A1). Labelled by Abdullah from the English captions (python -m app.planner.evaluate view) and storyboard frames where the captions were unclear, before running the classifier. A segment qualifies when it teaches or demonstrates something concrete the learner can do or reason about in code (writing, reading, debugging, testing, tracing an algorithm, or a CS concept with something to compute/trace). Intros, course ads, install/IDE setup, sponsors, opinions, career talk, math without code, music and talks never qualify. Long videos are labelled (and classified) only up to labelledUntilS. challenges: instructor-posed tasks; a question_posed pause at or after answerS (and before endS) is wrong.
